response.summary: Every open-question row in 002 to 008 appears in the sweep, the run table matches the phase records, and the close record leaves PR and acceptance pending as it should. Ten concerns remain. (1) Part D's review input was quietly narrowed: the record's description drops the milestone diff the close plan committed to, and some IL1/IL2 code has never had any review. (2) Three dispositions say fixed or discharged but leave residuals out: IL4-Q1's own-reference subtypes and IL1-Q3's out-of-set values. (3) Some verdicts overstate their evidence: predicate 1 omits the dropped learner-mismatch check, predicate 7 overstates review coverage, and IL5 omits the unreported version. (4) Two plan repairs are incomplete or untagged: IL6-C1 still says every adapter runs on refunds, and the status line has no (c) tag and contradicts section 8. (5) The gate predates the planning-text edits that one of its tests scans.
